name: cc-mermaid
description: Renders Mermaid diagrams from chat responses inline in the transcript (an SVG in Desktop, VS Code and mobile; Unicode in the terminal), with a self-contained HTML file and link as the fallback.

inline.title: Draw diagrams inline
inline.description: Draw mermaid diagrams in the transcript: an SVG in the Desktop app, VS Code and mobile, a Unicode diagram in the terminal. Rendered locally by the bundled beautiful-mermaid; off leaves the HTML link only.

theme.title: Inline diagram theme
theme.description: Colors for inline SVG diagrams. auto follows Claude Code's light or dark theme. One of: auto, zinc-light, zinc-dark, github-light, github-dark, tokyo-night, tokyo-night-storm, tokyo-night-light, catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-latte, nord, nord-light, dracula, solarized-light, solarized-dark, one-dark.
